label: Alex O'Connor, Christianity's Biggest…: An all-powerful god who truly loves us would not permit…
locator: Alex O'Connor, "Christianity's Biggest Problem" (Alex O'Connor, 2021-03-08), 00:51–01:46: why would an all-powerful god who truly loves us permit such suffering to overwhelm our living existence
interpretation: O'Connor's statement of the suffering form of the problem, which the video then sharpens into the problem of wild-animal suffering. The rhetorical question is read as asserting that such a god would not permit the actual suffering; a weaker reading takes it only as a request for a reason. The premise is itself a moral claim about what a loving god would do.
